decisions.reason: It fits the firm's stated push into agency-focused compliance features, has stayed on its own page for two years, and even limited positive feedback gives management enough justification to continue.
As a home-page product that builds directly on the core hosting offer, it reflects high public commitment and likely significant investment, which strongly favors persistence.

This managed hosting plan is close to the established business, remains actively presented, and in a growing market management can readily interpret any weaker uptake as temporary rather than a reason to exit.

It is the least publicly committed and newest offer, so it is the easiest to remove, but its strong fit with the firm's security-focused hosting model still makes continuation more likely than withdrawal.
